name: claude-pet
description: Desktop pet that shows Claude Code's running status with a cute pixel-art mascot. Reflects real-time states like reading, writing, executing, and handles permission requests through an interactive dialog.

interface.shortDescription: Cute desktop pet reflecting Claude Code status
interface.longDescription: A pixel-art desktop pet that lives on your screen and reflects Claude Code's real-time status through animations. See when Claude is reading, thinking, writing, or executing commands. Interactive permission dialog lets you approve or deny actions directly from the pet.
